purpose: Explain a technical argument to an engineering-plus-finance buyer, then get one action.
thesis: Most ways to cut an AI bill change what the model gives back. We only ship the ones that cannot.
audience: Companies with a large Anthropic API bill. Engineers who will check the claims, finance who will sign.

R2.1.value: Send a usage.json file and get an audit back. One CTA on the page, mailto angus@angusbuilds.com. The audit itself is $0.

R13.1.value: Claiming a saving that changes what the model returns. The product's whole guarantee is that the model reads the same bytes, the same model answers, and the same amount of thinking happens — a page that oversells past that has failed even if it converts. Second failure: any customer name, logo, testimonial, case study or customer metric appearing anywhere. None exist.
